metadata.title: ML Prediction Service
metadata.description: Upload ML models and make predictions via an intuitive web interface.

header.title: ML Prediction Service
header.subtitle: Upload model | Run predictions | Batch CSV

modelUpload.heading: Upload Model
modelUpload.description: Upload a serialized scikit-learn model (.pkl). The model will be held in memory for subsequent prediction requests.
modelUpload.invalidType: Invalid file type. Please upload a .pkl file.

predictForm.heading: Manual Prediction
predictForm.description: Enter feature name-value pairs that match your uploaded model's expected features, then run prediction to get a single result.
predictForm.emptyError: Please add at least one feature field with a non-empty name.
predictForm.predictionFailed: Prediction failed. Is the model loaded?

csvPredict.heading: CSV Batch Prediction
csvPredict.description: Upload a .csv dataset. Every row will be fed to the model and the annotated results returned in a table you can download.
csvPredict.batchFailed: Batch prediction failed. Is the model loaded?
